reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Transformator yetkazib berish uchun to'rtta ISO sertifikatining (jumladan, energiya menejmenti ISO 50001) to'liq to'plami 10 ball beradi, to'liq bo'lmasa 1 ball. Bu texnik qismning (50 ball) taxminan 18 foizini tashkil etadi va sertifikatlari bo'lmagan, ammo mahsulotni yetkaza oladigan ta'minotchilar ball yo'qotadi.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib moliyaviy talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Boshlang'ich narx 4 032 000 000 so'm, uning 30 foizi 1 209 600 000 so'm bo'ladi; shuncha qoldiq hisob raqamida bo'lishi 10 ball beradi, ma'lumot to'liq bo'lmasa 1 ball. Mol yetkazib beruvchi kichik va o'rta korxonalar bunday qoldiqni taklif sanasida ushlab turmasligi mumkin.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (platformadagi mezonlar): Ball my.mehnat.uz bazasi bilan integratsiyalangan xodimlar ro'yxatiga beriladi (to'liq bo'lmasa 1 ball). Xorijiy yoki bu bazada ro'yxatdan o'tmagan ishlab chiqaruvchi va ta'minotchilar uchun bu shartni bajarish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin; bitta transformator yetkazib berishda xodimlar soni natijaga bevosita bog'liq emas.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 33 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 2 ta; savdolarning 67% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 24%.
Diqqat: hujjatning 3 ta sahifasi mashina o'qiy olmaydigan skan, ular tahlil qilinmadi.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): A full set of four ISO certificates (including ISO 50001 energy management) earns 10 points, an incomplete set only 1 point. This is 9 points of the 50-point technical score, so suppliers who can deliver the transformer but lack all four certificates lose points on a requirement that is not tied to the product itself.

Financial demand out of proportion to the lot (platform criteria form): The start price is 4,032,000,000 UZS, so 30% is 1,209,600,000 UZS that must sit on the account on the bid date to earn 10 points (otherwise 1). Capable suppliers that do not keep such a balance idle on the account lose up to 9 points.

Other clause that may limit competition (platform criteria form): 10 points go to a staff list integrated with the my.mehnat.uz database (1 point if incomplete). Foreign manufacturers or suppliers not registered in that database may be unable to meet it, and for a single transformer delivery headcount is not directly tied to the outcome.
In the customer's last 33 deals the median number of bidders was 2; 67% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 24%.
Note: 3 page(s) of the document are scans without readable text and were not analysed.
